prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 86.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 94.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 72.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 93.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 80.3%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 44.2%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.

            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Playbook Stage
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated interactive playbook screen after home_intro demonstrating how to summon, drag, and talk to the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about users being unclear on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding.

new_pet_playbook.headline: Master Your Desktop Pet Controls
new_pet_playbook.body: Learn quick mouse gestures, hotkeys, and voice commands to summon or hide your pet anytime.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Studio Workbench Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pet selection step into a workbench layout where users preview animations and sound cues live before confirming adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops to 72.3% conversion and custom pet creation fails or disappoints users.

pick_friend.headline: Design Your Perfect Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a personality archetype and test its desktop behaviors in real time.

candidates.title: Pet Recovery Pin Account Safeguard Flow
candidates.change: Introduces an account recovery PIN creation option on the sign-in step to ensure pet state persistence across sessions.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account recovery confidence critical during sign in.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet Account & Sync State
sign_in.body: Set up instant pet recovery so your companion is never lost when logging in on new devices.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate First Experience Reorder
candidates.change: Reorders adoption certificate setup to occur prior to detailed trait selection so users claim ownership immediately.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 72.3% conversion rate and high median time (89s); claiming ownership early boosts completion motivation.

adoption_certificate.headline: Claim Your Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new desktop companion a name to begin your journey.

candidates.title: Desktop Taskbar Pinning Visual Guide
candidates.change: Displays an animated visual callout on the home_intro screen showing how to pin the pet app to the taskbar and system tray.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop or apps not opening after onboarding.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click the desktop pet tray icon anytime to bring your pet to the front or open controls.

candidates.title: Pet Spawn Status Interactive Checklist
candidates.change: Adds a step-by-step rendering status checklist to the waiting screen so users know desktop engine initialization is progressing.
candidates.why: The waiting (home) step takes 201s median / 2336s mean, and 3 support emails cited pets failing to display on desktop.

candidates.title: Path Outcome Clarity Headline Update
candidates.change: Rewrites path selection headlines to clearly explain the difference between choosing a preset pet vs creating a custom photo pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails cited custom pet generation looking wrong or failing, requiring clear expectations upfront at path selection.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Adoption Journey
choose_path.body: Choose Instant Preset Companion for immediate setup or Custom Photo Pet for personalized generation.
choose_path.hint: You can add more pets later from the desktop tray menu.

candidates.title: Desktop Engine Ready Audio Banner
candidates.change: Adds an opt-in audio chime notification toggle on the waiting screen when desktop asset compilation finishes.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s (38 mins), indicating users alt-tab away and miss when rendering completes.

waiting.body: We will play a gentle chime and alert you as soon as your pet lands on your screen.

candidates.title: Adoption Milestone Reward Badge
candidates.change: Displays an unlockable starter item badge on the adoption certificate screen upon completing pet naming.
candidates.why: Adoption step suffers a 27.7% drop-off; providing an immediate reward incentive boosts momentum into waiting.

components.text: Your pet will spawn on your desktop with an exclusive starter item!

candidates.title: Story Scroll Feature Spotlight Layout
candidates.change: Updates the story intro screen layout to a centered spotlight highlighting key desktop pet capabilities.
candidates.why: choose_path mean time is 514s, showing users hesitate early when digesting initial app concepts.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: Your pet lives directly on your Windows desktop, playing, walking, and keeping you company while you work.
